scenes.text: ChatGPT now *tracks your money* for free

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: On Oct 2, OpenAI opened Finances in ChatGPT to Free and Go users in the US.
Link your bank, cards and investments through Plaid. Credit report via Experian, optional.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Ask: "Which subscriptions did I pay for twice this year?" and "What is my net worth today?"
One dashboard: spending, net worth, portfolio, credit.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Read-only. It cannot move money, pay bills or trade. US only for now.
Disconnect and the data is deleted within 30 days. Source: OpenAI release notes, Oct 2, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Free and Go plans. No upgrade needed.
Plus and Pro already had it.

scenes.text: Would you link your bank to ChatGPT? *Yes or no* below.
